description: Follows Dmitri Mendeleev as he organized the elements into a periodic system, using recurring chemical properties and gaps to predict missing elements and test the classification. Distinguishes his atomic-weight and chemical reasoning from the later atomic-number explanation, and connects his chemistry to industrial and measurement work.
